description: Completely synthetic multi-document applicant packets covering 8 standard defect patterns.

PKT_01_CLEAN.description: Standard fully consistent applicant packet. All 6 documents match exactly.

PKT_LOOP3_DEMO.description: Loop 3 Multi-Modal Challenge Packet: Mixed vector and degraded OCR scans (uneven lighting, perspective distortion, low-resolution) with caste category defect.

PKT_02_NAME_CONFLICT.description: Marksheet belongs to Rajesh Kumar Patel instead of applicant Smruti Ranjan Nayak.

PKT_03_DOB_CONFLICT.description: Date of Birth mismatch: Application form declares 14/05/2003 but Marksheet states 14/05/2005.

PKT_04_INCOME_CONFLICT.description: Income Certificate states Rs. 3,20,000/- (exceeding statutory 2.5L ceiling and conflicting with declared 1.8L).

PKT_05_MISSING_CERTIFICATE.description: Mandatory Caste Certificate is absent from the packet.

PKT_06_MULTIPLE_DEFECTS.description: Multiple defects: Expired income certificate, academic marks below cutoff, DOB mismatch, passbook name discrepancy.

PKT_07_UNREADABLE_DOC.description: Income Certificate has illegible scan / corrupt text quality.

PKT_08_AMBIGUOUS_EVIDENCE.description: Date format ambiguity (04/05/2003 vs 05/04/2003) and Name initial variation ('S R Nayak' vs 'Smruti Ranjan Nayak').
